svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 04/12 Mount Sutro Forest (Uncommon)
svg.desc: A eucalyptus forest right above campus. Trails, ferns, and fog dripping off the leaves. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
